g.text: 160 synthetic objects at 350–650 km over a 240-day record with random storms. Truth: density with a lagged storm response; empirical model:
weaker, unlagged response. Forecasts assume Ap persists. Network (2 × 32 tanh, numpy) trained on days 3–150, tested on days 160–236.
